paper.title: People accurately predict the shape but not the parameters of skill learning curves
paper.license_note: Journal article has its own copyright; OSF project CC0 is not attributed to the published article. Paper was read as a primary source, not copied into the repository.

project.access: Public anonymous API read and OSF supplied versioned downloads; no credentials or contact with authors.

preregistration.use: Prospective original sample/exclusion rule; no outcome-dependent exclusion adopted for this pilot.

nonanalysis_declaration: No candidate model fit, slope evaluation, outcome-by-dose summary, trajectory plot, or chronological holdout score was generated in access work. Methods/source search exposed the published exponential claim; this is not a blind cohort.
